title: combined-by-merge finding is written by hand each time
what: One command, e.g. `relay check record merge -C <wt> <checked sha> --report <path>.json`, that runs `relay changed --own`, writes one finding per listed file (conflict or combined, line 1, MEDIUM, kind inside, the standard failing/pass cases) with reviewed = HEAD (the merge commit), and prints the path; fix delegate step 8 to name it and to say reviewed = the merge commit.
why: 24 Oct: 5 times today the front wrote a review TOML by hand after taking master (one finding per file from `relay changed --own`, reviewed = the merge commit sha); twice it guessed wrong first (short sha, head before the merge), and delegate step 8 says reviewed = the head before the merge, which makes the checker count the file as open. Repeats on every take-master that combines a file (MEDIUM).
failing_case: After `git merge master` combines tests/test_relay.py, there is no command that records the finding; following delegate step 8 literally (reviewed = head before the merge) makes the checker report open 1.
pass_cases: The command writes a review JSON the checker accepts with Fixes: none and reports open 0 when the gate is green; delegate step 8 matches the checker.
where: bin/relay (check record), lib/relay_verdict.py or relay_check, plugins/delegate/skills/delegate/SKILL.md step 8
dropped_why: Owner, verbatim, 24 Oct, on the check-record design's open question: "1. a" (drop this item once the redesign merges). The redesign merged 24 Oct; its test T6 covers this case (the combined-by-merge finding is recorded by relay check record review, not written by hand).
